directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

preserve: One BLAKE3 identity per normalized email; resend updates the same row only after an accepted send
Stored policy words, input checks, max invites, paged facts and observed joined/paid status
allowed_deltas: Use the public content identity and records door owners instead of retired Worker storage
Await record reads and writes; require admitted account/referral/membership owners explicitly; no Worker or guessed native fallback
Native records list pagination resumes after an account-scoped invitation row id instead of a retired KV cursor.
Absent admitted sign-in claims refuse arrival joins and discovery; the retired unsigned Network fallback is removed.
banned_substitutions: Guessed native operations or caller-authored proof of an email
Tests or archival source counted as active retained behavior
Missing owner treated as successful delivery or admission
_state: Exact source copied in the named ancestor at the canonical target path before the adaptation commit. Runtime host qualification remains separate; see README.
